title: provider._repository_of cuts a gitlab.com project whose group or name at depth 3 or more is blob, tree, raw or blame to the wrong slug
goal: kb/_self/tools.md names, where it describes read_licence's gitlab.com urls, that the legacy form without /-/ is cut at the first blob, tree, raw or blame word after the second path segment, so a project whose group or name at depth 3 or more is one of those words is read as the shorter slug, while a url with /-/ is read whole; the code stays as it is

run: import sys;L=[l for l in open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8') if 'legacy' in l and 'blame' in l];print(len(L));sys.exit(0 if L else 1)

repro_reason: the legacy and the nested reading of a gitlab.com path cannot be told apart from the path alone, so the planner settled the fix as the documentation of the cut and the repro reads tools.md for it

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import provider as p;u=p.urllib.parse.urlsplit;a=p._repository_of(u('https://gitlab.com/a/b/tree/c'));b=p._repository_of(u('https://gitlab.com/a/b/-/tree/main/x'));print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if a and b and a[1]=='a/b' and b[1]=='a/b' else 1)
